description: Get a provider signup link for a non-electricity utility (internet, gas, water, trash) at a Texas address, after the user has chosen a provider and wants to sign up themselves. Use when the user says 'give me the link to sign up for this internet plan'. Returns a signup URL that the user follows to enroll directly with the provider, plus a signup_id (track with check_signup_status). Utilify does not enroll anyone and does not act for the user. Electricity: Utilify does not enroll electricity plans; calling this tool with an electricity provider returns a refusal (refused: true) pointing to https://www.powertochoose.org, the provider's own website, and the Utilify concierge at https://utilify.io/concierge. Caveats: (1) user-initiated only; confirm the provider and address in the conversation before calling. (2) If the user wants a person at Utilify to handle setup, point them to the Utilify concierge at https://utilify.io/concierge: a paid service (USD 49, paid by the user) in which the user approves every choice and accepts a written agreement on that page, instead of calling this tool.

address.description: Full service address including city, state, and ZIP code

move_in_date.description: ISO 8601 date for desired service start

plan_id.description: The specific plan the user chose

provider_id.description: The provider to sign up with. Accepts either the provider UUID (from search_utility_providers) or the provider slug (e.g. "chariot-energy").
